# ShowPointer

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Display](BlitzBasic-Display)

## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
ShowPointer
```

## Description

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Shows the mouse pointer again after [HidePointer](HidePointer).
